changes.title: Keep low-memory diagnostic capture from replacing the original failure
changes.text: Guard diagnostic message and stack capture when stack allocation itself throws. Preserve the original failure text and mark diagnostics unavailable instead of throwing a second failure. This is diagnostic hardening, not proof that the reported phone black screen was caused by memory exhaustion.

changes.title: Compile the retained native loot-scroll coordinate check
changes.text: TEST327 passed strict history, full core, assembly and the matched player build, but API34 and every display job stopped before native execution because one new test referenced nonexistent display fields. Use Game.width and Game.height, the engine's actual public EGL surface dimensions, while retaining the same on-screen coordinate assertion and all native timing, save, input and screenshot requirements.

commentary: Immediate previous compiled APK is TEST327 source c77cb625/run40786801089/label Codex TEST 327.
